userId.description: The unique identifier of the user.

anyOf.description: The real name of the user.

realName.description: The real name of the user.

anyOf.description: The display name of the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

anyOf.description: Whether the user is a bot user.

isBot.description: Whether the user is a bot user.

anyOf.description: Whether the user is an admin.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an admin.

anyOf.description: Whether the user is an owner.

isOwner.description: Whether the user is an owner.

locale.description: The locale returned by Slack when requested.

email.description: The profile email. Slack returns it only when the token holds the users:read.email scope.

tz.description: The user's time zone identifier when Slack provides it.

tzOffset.description: The user's UTC offset in seconds when Slack provides it.

updated.description: When the user object was last updated, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

teamId.description: The user's team ID when Slack provides it.

isRestricted.description: Whether the user is a guest. Single-channel guests also set isUltraRestricted.

isUltraRestricted.description: Whether the user is a single-channel guest.

isAppUser.description: Whether the user is an authorized user of the calling app.

anyOf.description: The cursor for the next page.

nextCursor.description: The cursor for the next page.

description: The output payload for this action.
